ai.title: 5paisa Capital Partners with OpenAI to Bring AI
ai.description: Fintech firm 5paisa Capital has partnered with OpenAI to introduce artificial intelligence-driven features across its investing and trading platform. The collaboration will provide personalised insights, portfolio analysis, market updates and decision support to retail investors. As part of the partnership, 5paisa plans to become the first broking platform to make its services accessible within ChatGPT, enabling users to interact with investing tools through conversational AI. The company said the initiative aims to create a more intuitive and personalised investing experience while ensuring that users remain in control of their investment decisions.
